questions.markdown:
250kg of feed water enters the boiler at a temperature of $27^\circ\text{C}$. steam at a pressure of $1.5\ \text{N/mm}^2$ leaves the boiler as $17.5\%$ wet and enters the super heater where it is superheated to a temperature of $310^\circ\text{C}$. Further, from the super heater if the steam is led to a heat exchanger for process heating where it loses $65.8\%$ of enthalpy, determine the following;

i) Total heat supplied to water in the boiler

ii) Total heat supplied steam in the superheater.

iii) The condition and related parameter of the steam at the exit point of heat exchanger.

Assume the specific heat of water as $4.187\ \text{kJ/KgK}$ and that of super-heated steam as $2.25\ \text{kJ/KgsK}$.

Boilers A and B supply steam to a common pipeline at a ratio of $7:3$ at a pressure of $185\ \text{N/cm}^2$. The steam from boiler-A is at temperature $280^\circ\text{C}$, while the condition of steam from boiler-B is unknown. The steam in the common pipeline is $18\%$ wet at $1.85\ \text{MPa}$. The calorific value of fuel supplied to boiler-A is $39.5\ \text{MJ/kg}$ and boiler-B is $37.75\ \text{MJ/kg}$. Compute the condition of steam supplied by boiler-B.

Assume specific heat of superheated steam and saturated water as $2.25\ \text{kJ/kgK}$ and $4.187\ \text{kJ/kgK}$ respectively.
Explain any three boiler accessories, that enhance the efficiency of a boiler.

A belt drive is used to transmit the power from a DC motor to the head-stock in a lathe machine. DC motor shaft rotates at a constant speed of $1200\ \text{rpm}$. The centre distance between the shaft of the belt drive is $1.85\ \text{m}$. The speed reduction ratio is $3.5$, and the angle of contact on the smaller pulley is $4.15$ radians. The larger pulley has a diameter of $80\ \text{cm}$. The initial belt tension is $850\ \text{N}$ and the coefficient of friction is $0.25$, sketch the arrangement and calculate the following:

i) Power transmitted in the belt drive

ii) Length of the belt drive

iii) Width of the belt drive, if permissible tension in the belt drive is $8\text{kN}$ per meter width of the belt.

The following gear wheels are available to form a compound gear train. Sketch the arrangement of the gear train using four shafts, to obtain highest velocity ratio at the output shaft and calculate the same. Also mention the conditions used to achieve the condition.

questions.markdown:
Comment on the following:

i. Life of the belt in cross belt drive is lower as compared with open belt drive.

ii. Friction is an helpful agent in case of transmission of power using belts

iii. Contact area of the belt on the pulley influences the power transmission.
Illustrating thermodynamic events explain working of an IC engine that directly admits the charge and operates with a compression ratio of $18:1$.

The following observations were recorded during a test on a 4-stroke engine. Bore=$15\ \text{cm}$, Stroke $=20\ \text{cm}$, Cam Shaft Speed=$250\ \text{rpm}$, Mean effective pressure=$8\ \text{bar}$, Fuel consumption=$0.0013\ \text{kg/sec}$, Calorific value of the fuel=$43900\ \text{kJ/kg}$. Determine the indicated thermal efficiency.

Give suitable reasons for the following:

i) For the same capacity four stroke engines are heavy and bulkier as compared to two stroke engines.

ii) Two stroke petrol engines generate more pollution as compared to four stroke petrol engines.

iii) Multi cylinder engine requires a lighter flywheel as compared to a single cylinder engine.

A simple refrigerant cycle uses R134a. The evaporator and condenser pressures are $0.234\ \text{MPa}$ and $1.01\ \text{MPa}$ respectively. After compression the refrigerant is superheated by $10\ ^\circ\text{C}$ Determine:

i) COP of the cycle

ii) Refrigerating capacity if the mass flow is $7\ \text{kg/min}$.

Assume that at the exit of the evaporator the refrigerant is dry.

Write a short note on:

i) Unit of refrigeration

ii) Coefficient of Performance

Write the functions of the following lathe parts:

i. Chuck

ii. Tailstock

iii. Bed
Explain Clausius statement and Kelvin Plank statement.
List and explain any 3 advantages of CNC machines.
What are the various stages in producing a part using additive manufacturing technique.
